respuesta.pregunta: I'm writing a client for payment-promise-gateway. How does the service handle errors? What should I expect back when something goes wrong?
respuesta.respuesta:
Both documented versions, 0.0.10-test-crc-migration and latest, describe error handling the same way. The service follows a standardized approach with four parts:

- HTTP status codes on API responses
- detailed error messages
- custom exceptions for business logic
- the same error format across all responses

[payment-promise-gateway/0.0.10-test-crc-migration/guide/README.md:L532-L536] [payment-promise-gateway/latest/guide/README.md:L532-L536]

So your client can count on HTTP status codes and a consistent error format. Neither version documents the specific status codes or the field structure of the error body. For those details, the README points to the detailed API documentation in specs-hub [payment-promise-gateway/latest/guide/README.md:L114-L114].
